items.followUp: Give two differences between skeletal and cardiac muscles.

rubric.why: Voluntary muscles are controlled consciously, whereas involuntary muscles work without conscious control.
rubric.description: Compares how the two types of muscles are controlled.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for correctly contrasting voluntary and involuntary control.

rubric.why: Voluntary muscles are usually attached to bones, while involuntary muscles are found in the walls of internal organs.
rubric.description: Compares the usual locations of the two types of muscles.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for correctly stating that voluntary muscles are usually attached to bones and involuntary muscles are found in internal organs.

modelAnswer: Voluntary muscles work under conscious control; involuntary muscles work without conscious control.
Voluntary muscles are usually attached to bones, whereas involuntary muscles are found in the walls of internal organs.
